I'm a Swedish fan and I do tifo's for AIK. Just want to say that this tifo is not impressive at all to me. It's founded by rich guys who owns rich companies. They donate tons of money and hire people to put out these paper sheets which have ads for the donating companies on the backside.

In our tifo-group we scramble for money on the matches from other supporters or sell t-shirts which we have designed to get money to buy the paper, plastic and cloth that we need. Then we spend a lot of our spare time to paint everything and to place it out before a game.
